sentences.text:
3. Jaibir Yadav @ Jaibir Kumar S/O Baleshwar Yadav Resident Of Nandlal
 Chapra, P.S. Ram Krishna Nagar, District Patna.

4. Shivjee Yadav S/O Rajendra Prasad Resident Of Mohalla East
 Laxminagar, Khemnichak, P.S. Ram Krishna Nagar, District Patna.

1. The State Of Bihar  .... .... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE AKHILESH CHANDRA  ORAL ORDER 3 10-12-2013 Heard the parties.

Petitioners apprehend their arrest in connection with a case for the offence punishable under sections 341, 323, 353, 427, 504/34 of the I.P.C. and sections 62, 63 and 31 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, who are named accused in this case but only with assertion of having involvement without any specific accusation.

Submission is of false implication, nothing specific against them, nor as is evident from order of the learned Sessions Judge, any attempt was made to show their conduct after getting its view through recording of C.C. T.V. Camera.

Further petitioners carrying only three cases, namely, Ram Krishna Nagar P.S. Case No. 24 of 2012, Ram Krishna Nagar P.S. Case No. 39 of 2012 and Ram Krishna Nagar P.S. Case No. 68 of 2012, wherein they are on bail.

If it is so, in the event of arrest/surrender before the court below within four weeks, the above named petitioners shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand)
each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of C.J.M. Patna in Ram Krishna Nagar P.S. Case No. 127 of 2012, subject to conditions as laid down in section 438 (2) of Cr.P.C. with additional conditions to remain physically present before the court below on each and every date at least for two years or till disposal of the case which ever is earlier and in case of failure on two Tuntun Yadav & Ors vs The State Of Bihar on 10 December, 2013 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176086613/
1 consecutive dates without giving any reasonable explanation, the privilege granted shall be deemed to be cancelled.
(Akhilesh Chandra, J) Abhay/-
